ep-ench-1.texto: Some things are up to us, and some are not.
ep-ench-1.texto_curto: Some things are up to us; others are not.
ep-ench-1.reflexao: Weather, elevation and rivals aren't up to you. Pace, fueling and attitude are.

ma-4-49.texto: Be like the headland against which the waves keep breaking; it stands firm, and the water calms around it.
ma-4-49.texto_curto: Be the headland: waves break, it stands.
ma-4-49.reflexao: In the hardest stretch you don't have to beat the wave. Just stay standing.

sen-ep13-4.texto: We suffer more often in imagination than in reality.
sen-ep13-4.texto_curto: We suffer more often in imagination than in reality.
sen-ep13-4.reflexao: The race you picture at 3 a.m. is always harder than the real one.

mm-gorin-agua-mente.texto: In the way of strategy, do not let your mind change from its everyday state: keep it broad and straight, neither tense nor slack.
mm-gorin-agua-mente.texto_curto: In battle the mind doesn't change: broad, straight, not tense.
mm-gorin-agua-mente.reflexao: Don't save a special version of yourself for race day. Today's calm is the calm at the start line.

mm-gorin-agua-postura.texto: Make your everyday stance your combat stance, and your combat stance your everyday stance.
mm-gorin-agua-postura.texto_curto: Make daily life your training, and training your daily life.
mm-gorin-agua-postura.reflexao: Posture, breathing, patience in a slow line: it's all training for the final miles.

mm-gorin-agua-mil-dias.texto: A thousand days of practice to forge, ten thousand days to polish.
mm-gorin-agua-mil-dias.texto_curto: A thousand days of practice to forge, ten thousand to polish.
mm-gorin-agua-mil-dias.reflexao: One bad week doesn't undo a thousand days. One good week doesn't replace them either.

ts-fudochi-definicao.texto: Immovable does not mean being like stone or wood. The mind moves forward, to the sides, in every direction, never stopping anywhere: that is immovable wisdom.
ts-fudochi-definicao.texto_curto: Immovable isn't stone: it's a mind that moves and never gets stuck.
ts-fudochi-definicao.reflexao: Fudōshin isn't being rigid. It's moving on without clinging to pain, the watch or fear.

dg-regra-40.texto: When your mind says you're done, your body still has much more to give. Fatigue shows up long before the limit.
dg-regra-40.texto_curto: When the mind says you're done, there's still more.
dg-regra-40.reflexao: At the mile where everything begs you to stop, remember: that warning comes early on purpose.

dg-vitorias.texto: In the hardest moments, reach back for the struggles you've already overcome. They're fuel.
dg-vitorias.texto_curto: In the hard stretch, recall the wins you already have.
dg-vitorias.reflexao: Think of your toughest session this year. You got through it. You'll get through today too.

dg-mente-calejada.texto: Doing hard things on purpose, when no one is watching, prepares the mind for the day you have no choice.
dg-mente-calejada.texto_curto: Doing hard things on purpose toughens the mind.
dg-mente-calejada.reflexao: The session you didn't want to do is the one that counts most on race day.

dg-espelho.texto: Be honest with yourself about where you are and what's missing. Change starts without excuses.
dg-espelho.texto_curto: Be honest with yourself: progress starts without excuses.
dg-espelho.reflexao: Look at last week without dressing it up. What did you do? What will you do differently?

ek-disciplina.texto: Discipline doesn't confine you: it's what sets an athlete free.
ek-disciplina.texto_curto: Discipline doesn't confine you: it sets you free.
ek-disciplina.reflexao: Keeping the promise to yourself, even when you don't feel like it, is what frees you on race day.

ek-limites.texto: The limits you imagine usually sit well before your real ones.
ek-limites.texto_curto: The limit you imagine comes before the real one.
ek-limites.reflexao: Before you say you can't, ask: is that a fact or a fear?

ek-sorriso.texto: Smiling in the hardest stretch relaxes the body and tells the mind everything is under control.
ek-sorriso.texto_curto: Smile in the hard stretch: the body relaxes, the mind settles.
ek-sorriso.reflexao: When the pain tightens, drop your shoulders and smile. It seems small, but it changes your stride.

ek-constancia.texto: Results come from everyday consistency, not from one heroic workout.
ek-constancia.texto_curto: Results come from consistency, not one heroic workout.
ek-constancia.reflexao: Today's run doesn't need to be epic. It needs to happen, and tomorrow too.

fd-nao-desista.texto: If you don't quit, you still have a chance.
fd-nao-desista.texto_curto: If you don't quit, you still have a chance.
fd-nao-desista.reflexao: As long as you keep going, the race isn't over.

pj-nanakorobi-yaoki.texto: Fall seven times, stand up eight.
pj-nanakorobi-yaoki.texto_curto: Fall seven times, stand up eight.

fd-conforto.texto: No one achieves anything great in comfort. Grow a little every day.
fd-conforto.texto_curto: Nothing of value is born from comfort.
fd-conforto.reflexao: Everyone wakes up tired and unwilling. Those who want to grow get up and go anyway.

fd-forca-vontade.texto: Willpower is built by doing hard things, again and again.
fd-forca-vontade.texto_curto: Do hard things, again and again.
fd-forca-vontade.reflexao: Do what needs to be done, no excuses. That is how willpower is built.

fd-crescimento.texto: Growth comes when we face and overcome our limits.
fd-crescimento.reflexao: The session you want to skip is often the one that makes you grow the most.

fd-mude.texto: You are the only person with the power to change yourself.
fd-mude.reflexao: When you change, everything changes with you.

jr-mais-habilidade.texto: Instead of asking for fewer problems, seek more skill to solve them.
jr-mais-habilidade.texto_curto: Seek more skill, not fewer problems.
jr-mais-habilidade.reflexao: You have a choice: stay as you are or become someone better.

fd-disciplina.reflexao: It isn't talent or luck. It's your decision to act.

fd-excecao.texto: Be the person who makes others ask: how do they keep going?
fd-excecao.reflexao: No one sees the early-morning runs. Everyone sees who is still standing at the end.

fd-apresentese.texto: Don't complain, don't explain. Show up and do your best.
fd-apresentese.texto_curto: Don't complain. Show up and do your best.
fd-apresentese.reflexao: Champions don't complain or whine. They're too busy getting better.

fd-sem-volta.texto: Once you've seen who you can become, there's no going back.
fd-sem-volta.texto_curto: Once you see who you can become, there's no going back.
fd-sem-volta.reflexao: There is always room to do more, and better.

fd-desconforto.texto: Learn to be comfortable with discomfort.
fd-desconforto.reflexao: Today's discomfort is tomorrow's easy pace.

fd-desafio.texto: The challenge is the force you need to level up.
fd-desafio.texto_curto: The challenge is what makes you level up.
fd-desafio.reflexao: If the race scares you, it's because it matters.

fd-persistencia.texto: Nothing beats persistence. Not luck, not talent.
fd-persistencia.texto_curto: Nothing beats persistence. Not luck, not talent.
fd-persistencia.reflexao: Change the way you think and you change the way you train.

fd-derrotas.texto: The wise learn more from defeats than from victories.
fd-derrotas.texto_curto: Learn more from defeats than from victories.
fd-derrotas.reflexao: A bad run is a lesson. Note it and try again.

fd-manha.texto: Morning is the moment of truth. Get up and do what needs to be done.
fd-manha.reflexao: Mornings bring the day's first decisions. Don't negotiate with laziness.

ma-7-69.texto: Perfection of character is to live each day as if it were the last, without frenzy, without sloth, without pretense.
ma-7-69.texto_curto: Live each day without frenzy, without sloth, without pretense.
ma-7-69.reflexao: Train today as if it were the only session that matters. No rush, no shortcuts.

ma-8-36.texto: Do not disturb yourself by thinking of your whole life. Ask only: what is unbearable in this moment?
ma-8-36.texto_curto: Don't think of your whole life. What is unbearable right now?
ma-8-36.reflexao: Don't think about the 100 km ahead. Think about this kilometer. You can handle it.

ma-7-8.texto: Never let the future disturb you. You will meet it, if you must, with the same reason you use today.
ma-7-8.texto_curto: Don't let the future disturb you. You'll meet it when it comes.
ma-7-8.reflexao: Pre-race nerves are imagination. Tomorrow you'll have the same tools as today.

ma-8-32.texto: Build your life action by action.
ma-8-32.texto_curto: Build your life action by action.
ma-8-32.reflexao: One run doesn't make an athlete. A hundred finished runs do. Today was one more.

ma-6-2.texto: Let it make no difference whether you are cold or warm, as long as you are doing your duty.
ma-6-2.texto_curto: Cold or warm, it doesn't matter: do your duty.
ma-6-2.reflexao: Rain, heat or wind aren't in your control. Today's session is.

ma-5-20.texto: The impediment to action advances action. What stands in the way becomes the way.
ma-5-20.texto_curto: What stands in the way becomes the way.
ma-5-20.reflexao: The injury, the lost week, the bad run: all of it becomes part of the preparation.

ma-4-17.texto: Do not live as if you had ten thousand years ahead. While you live, while you can, be good.
ma-4-17.texto_curto: Don't live as if you had ten thousand years ahead.
ma-4-17.reflexao: The run postponed to tomorrow often becomes the run that never happened.

sen-ep1-1.texto: Claim yourself for yourself, and gather the time that until now was taken from you or slipped away.
sen-ep1-1.reflexao: No one will hand you a free hour to train. You take it.

sen-ep2-2.texto: Those who are everywhere are nowhere.
sen-ep2-2.texto_curto: Those who are everywhere are nowhere.
sen-ep2-2.reflexao: One goal at a time. Today, it's today's session.

sen-ep71-3.texto: If you don't know which port you are sailing to, no wind is favorable.
sen-ep71-3.texto_curto: No wind is favorable if you don't know your port.
sen-ep71-3.reflexao: Without a race on the calendar, every run feels optional. Choose your port.

sen-ep78-13.texto: Pain is slight if opinion adds nothing to it.
sen-ep78-13.texto_curto: Pain is slight if opinion adds nothing to it.
sen-ep78-13.reflexao: Your legs hurt. The story you tell about the pain is what can double it.

sen-ep96-5.texto: To live, Lucilius, is to fight.
sen-ep96-5.texto_curto: To live, Lucilius, is to fight.
sen-ep96-5.reflexao: Don't wait for the race to get easy. Get strong enough for it.

sen-ep28-2.texto: You need a change of soul, not a change of climate.
sen-ep28-2.texto_curto: You need a change of soul, not a change of climate.
sen-ep28-2.reflexao: New shoes, new watch, new plan. None of it helps without a change of mind.

sen-prov-5-10.texto: Fire tests gold; hardship tests the brave.
sen-prov-5-10.texto_curto: Fire tests gold; hardship tests the brave.
sen-prov-5-10.reflexao: Today's hard session isn't punishment. It's the test that shows what you're made of.

sen-brev-1-3.texto: It is not that we have a short time to live, but that we waste much of it.
sen-brev-1-3.texto_curto: It's not that we have little time, but that we waste much.
sen-brev-1-3.reflexao: Resting isn't wasting time. Scrolling for two hours is.

ep-ench-8.texto: Don't demand that things happen as you wish. Wish them to happen as they do, and you will live in peace.
ep-ench-8.texto_curto: Don't demand things go your way. Accept the way they go.
ep-ench-8.reflexao: Rain on race day? Accept the rain. Fighting it only wastes energy.

ep-ench-51.texto: How long will you put off demanding the best of yourself? Now is the contest; the games have begun.
ep-ench-51.texto_curto: How long will you wait? The games have already begun.
ep-ench-51.reflexao: There's no perfect Monday to start again. There's today.

ep-disc-1-24.texto: It is difficulties that show what people are.
ep-disc-1-24.texto_curto: It is difficulties that show what people are.
ep-disc-1-24.reflexao: The hardest climb of the race doesn't define you. It reveals what you've already built.

ep-disc-2-18.texto: Every habit is strengthened by the corresponding actions: walking by walking, running by running.
ep-disc-2-18.texto_curto: The habit of running is strengthened by running.
ep-disc-2-18.reflexao: It doesn't need to be a great session. It needs to be one more. The habit is the training.

mm-gorin-chi-tanren.reflexao: There are no shortcuts. There is the way, trained every day.

mm-gorin-chi-pequeno.texto: Pay attention even to small things.
mm-gorin-chi-pequeno.texto_curto: Pay attention even to small things.
mm-gorin-chi-pequeno.reflexao: Laces, socks, gels, sleep. Long races are lost in the details.

mm-gorin-chi-invisivel.texto: Perceive and understand what the eyes cannot see.
mm-gorin-chi-invisivel.texto_curto: Perceive and understand what the eyes cannot see.
mm-gorin-chi-invisivel.reflexao: No one sees recovery happening. But rest is when the body gets stronger.

pj-keizoku.reflexao: No one will remember today's run a year from now. Everyone will see the result of a year of runs.

pj-ame-futte.texto: After the rain, the ground hardens.
pj-ame-futte.texto_curto: After the rain, the ground hardens.
pj-ame-futte.reflexao: The run that went wrong also makes you stronger. After it, you stand on firmer ground.

pj-senri.texto: Even a thousand-league road begins with one step.
pj-senri.texto_curto: Even a thousand-league road begins with one step.
pj-senri.reflexao: The ultra doesn't start at the start line. It started with your first run. Take today's.

pj-shoshin.reflexao: Remember the joy of your first run? It's still there, under the watch and the goals.

pj-anzuru.reflexao: Tomorrow's session is scarier in your head than it will be on the road.

lz-33.texto: One who conquers others is strong; one who conquers oneself is mighty.
lz-33.texto_curto: Conquering others is strength; conquering yourself is might.
lz-33.reflexao: Your race is against the clock and the terrain. The real fight is against the urge to stop.

lz-76.texto: The hard and stiff are companions of death; the soft and supple, companions of life.
lz-76.texto_curto: The rigid breaks; the supple lives.
lz-76.reflexao: Stretch, loosen up, rest. The body that's too rigid is the one that gets hurt.

hr-b91.texto: No one steps into the same river twice.
hr-b91.texto_curto: No one steps into the same river twice.
hr-b91.reflexao: Today's body isn't yesterday's. Respect what it asks for now.

fd-descanso-treino.texto: Rest isn't a pause from training. It's part of it.
fd-descanso-treino.texto_curto: Rest isn't a pause from training. It's part of it.
fd-descanso-treino.reflexao: Muscle doesn't grow during the run. It grows when you let it recover.

fd-descanso-culpa.texto: Resting without guilt takes discipline too.
fd-descanso-culpa.texto_curto: Resting without guilt takes discipline too.
fd-descanso-culpa.reflexao: Staying still on the right day is as hard as running on the hard day.

fd-sono-ajuste.texto: Slept badly? Adjust the plan, don't abandon it.
fd-sono-ajuste.texto_curto: Slept badly? Adjust the plan, don't abandon it.
fd-sono-ajuste.reflexao: Today an easy run done beats a hard run forced.

fd-sono-escuta.texto: Listening to your body is strength too.
fd-sono-escuta.texto_curto: Listening to your body is strength too.
fd-sono-escuta.reflexao: Accumulated fatigue isn't beaten by stubbornness. It's beaten by sleep.

fd-sono-calma.texto: One bad night doesn't erase weeks of training.
fd-sono-calma.texto_curto: One bad night doesn't erase weeks of training.
fd-sono-calma.reflexao: Almost no one sleeps well before a race. What carries you is the sleep of the weeks before.

fd-sono-leve.texto: Today, do less and do it well.
fd-sono-leve.texto_curto: Today, do less and do it well.
fd-sono-leve.reflexao: An easy run with a clear head beats a hard run on an empty body.

fd-pos-feito.texto: Done. No one can take today's run away from you.
fd-pos-feito.texto_curto: Done. No one can take today's run away from you.
fd-pos-feito.reflexao: Keep this run. On the hard day of the race, it will be there.

fd-pos-gratidao.texto: Thank the legs that brought you here.
fd-pos-gratidao.texto_curto: Thank the legs that brought you here.
fd-pos-gratidao.reflexao: Hydrate, eat, stretch. Caring for your body afterwards respects what it just did.

fd-pos-ruim.texto: A bad run still counts. You showed up.
fd-pos-ruim.texto_curto: A bad run still counts. You showed up.
fd-pos-ruim.reflexao: Not every run is good. Every run done is one more brick.

fd-pos-silencio.reflexao: You won't see progress in a day. You'll see it looking back in six months.

fd-retorno-recomeco.texto: Starting over isn't going back to zero. It's coming back with experience.
fd-retorno-recomeco.texto_curto: Starting over isn't zero. It's coming back with experience.
fd-retorno-recomeco.reflexao: Your fitness dropped, but what you learned stayed. Start easy.

fd-retorno-volte.texto: You don't need to pick up where you left off. You just need to come back.
fd-retorno-volte.texto_curto: You don't need to resume where you stopped. Just come back.
fd-retorno-volte.reflexao: Ten minutes today are worth more than the perfect workout you keep postponing.

fd-retorno-paciencia.texto: Come back patiently. The body remembers, but it needs time.
fd-retorno-paciencia.texto_curto: Come back patiently. The body remembers, but it needs time.
fd-retorno-paciencia.reflexao: Increase volume gradually. Rushing to make up lost time is what hurts most.

fd-retorno-lesao.reflexao: Understand what caused it, adjust, and come back smarter.

fd-prova-confie.texto: The training is done. Now, trust it.
fd-prova-confie.texto_curto: The training is done. Now, trust it.
fd-prova-confie.reflexao: In the final days you can't gain fitness. You can arrive rested and calm.

fd-prova-ritmo.texto: Start calm. The race begins in the middle.
fd-prova-ritmo.texto_curto: Start calm. The race begins in the middle.
fd-prova-ritmo.reflexao: Those who go out too fast pay the bill at the end. Save energy for when it matters.

fd-prova-dor.texto: The pain will come. You knew it, and you came anyway.
fd-prova-dor.texto_curto: The pain will come. You knew it, and you came anyway.
fd-prova-dor.reflexao: Don't panic when it hurts. That was part of the plan from the start.

fd-prova-posto.texto: In a long race, there's only the next aid station.
fd-prova-posto.texto_curto: In a long race, there's only the next aid station.
fd-prova-posto.reflexao: Break up the distance. No one runs 100 km. They run from one aid station to the next, many times.

fd-vespera-simples.texto: The day before, nothing new. Keep it simple.
fd-vespera-simples.texto_curto: The day before, nothing new. Keep it simple.
fd-vespera-simples.reflexao: Same dinner, same tested kit, same routine. The day for experiments is gone.

fd-vespera-tensao.texto: Nerves before a hard session mean it matters.
fd-vespera-tensao.texto_curto: Nerves before a hard session mean it matters.
fd-vespera-tensao.reflexao: Use the tension. It's energy waiting for direction.

fd-pouco-sempre.texto: Running a little always beats running a lot sometimes.
fd-pouco-sempre.texto_curto: Running a little always beats running a lot sometimes.
fd-pouco-sempre.reflexao: A week of four solid runs builds more than a week of one epic run.

fd-respire.texto: When everything tightens, come back to your breath.
fd-respire.texto_curto: When everything tightens, come back to your breath.
fd-respire.reflexao: Calm breathing, loose shoulders, short stride. Start with what you control.

fd-ego.texto: Leave your ego at home. Run the session the plan calls for.
fd-ego.texto_curto: Leave your ego at home. Run the session the plan calls for.
fd-ego.reflexao: Easy runs are meant to be easy. Speeding up on easy days leaves you tired on the day that counts.

fd-comparacao.texto: Compare yourself only with who you were yesterday.
fd-comparacao.texto_curto: Compare yourself only with who you were yesterday.
fd-comparacao.reflexao: Other people's pace online isn't your training. Your path is yours.

fd-mente-firme.texto: The body moves. The mind does not.
fd-mente-firme.texto_curto: The body moves. The mind does not.
fd-mente-firme.reflexao: Let the legs do the work. The mind stays steady, watching, unshaken.

fd-clima.texto: The weather outside doesn't decide your training. You do.
fd-clima.texto_curto: The weather outside doesn't decide your training. You do.
fd-clima.reflexao: Rain is just water. Heat is just heat. Adjust your kit and pace, and go.

fd-semana-leve.texto: An easy week isn't a lost week.
fd-semana-leve.texto_curto: An easy week isn't a lost week.
fd-semana-leve.reflexao: Planned recovery is what makes the next hard week possible.

fd-mente-descansa.texto: Today, let your mind rest too.
fd-mente-descansa.texto_curto: Today, let your mind rest too.
fd-mente-descansa.reflexao: No spreadsheet, no watch, no goals for one day. Come back tomorrow with a light head.

fd-pos-longao.texto: After the long run, the job is to recover.
fd-pos-longao.texto_curto: After the long run, the job is to recover.
fd-pos-longao.reflexao: Eat, drink, sleep. Today's run only becomes fitness if you rest.

fd-escolha.texto: No one will run for you. And that is a freedom.
fd-escolha.texto_curto: No one will run for you. And that is a freedom.
fd-escolha.reflexao: Today the decision is yours alone. It's heavy, but it's also what makes the win yours.

perguntas_diario: What was up to you in today's run, and did you do it?
What wasn't up to you, and did you let it go?
Which thought got in the way? Which one helped?
